title: Aircrew of Lancaster  PB512
memorial_details:
description: (RAF Badge)/ TO THE GLORY OF GOD AND IN EVERLASTING MEMORY/ OF THE GALLANT LANCASTER BOMBER AIRCREW OF/ 582 PATHFINDER SQUADRON WHO DIED IN A CRASH NEAR THIS/ CHURCH ON 23 SEPTEMBER 1944/ (Names)/ (582 Pathfinders badge)/ 582 PATHFINDERS SQUADRON/ No. 582 Squadron was formed on 1 April 1944 at Little Staughton from detachments of Nos. 7 and 156/ Squadrons. As part of No. 8 (Pathfinder) Group, it became operational on 9th April 
and continued bombing/ and target marking missions for the rest of the war. On 18th September 1945, the squadron was disbanded.
